messages:
claire: noticed a spike in Vault write failures for our helper service this morning. dig in shows several secrets under secret/legacy/contain plaintext SA JSONs. tagging ops/sec.
ben: ugh. can you paste one redacted example and the paths? we need scope quickly.
claire: redacted snippet: `{
  \"type\": \"service_account\",
  \"client_email\": \"batch-sync@redwood-qa.iam.gserviceaccount.com\",
  \"private_key_id\": \"...\"
}`
paths: secret/legacy/batch-sync, secret/legacy/partner-legacy, secret/adhoc/old-ci (so far).
vault-bot: [Alert] plain-sa-json-detected paths=[secret/legacy/batch-sync,secret/legacy/partner-legacy,secret/adhoc/old-ci] severity=high ticket=SEC-4120
mica: immediate priority: mark keys compromised, revoke, create new keys, and ensure we never reintroduce plaintext into Vault. also we must tighten KMS decrypt RBAC.
ben: I'm listing keys now: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=batch-sync@redwood-qa.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-qa --format=json` -> returned 2 keys (old ones). I'll delete both and create a new key.
claire: stop before you write any plaintext to disk. use envelope encrypt with KMS and store ciphertext in Vault. recommend flow: create key locally, use `gcloud kms encrypt` to produce ciphertext, then `vault kv put secret/qa/batch-sync wrapped=@ciphertext`.
ben: doing create+wrap flow. also temporarily re-add KMS decrypt permission for infra-decryptor so services can fetch until helpers are updated.
mica: please keep the regrant short-lived. we should rotate KMS wrapping key if the policy shows any broad principals. infra-bot, can you dump `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` for the wrap key?
infra-bot: [Task] kms-policy-dump key=legacy-wrap keyring=shared location=global project=redwood-kms ticket=OPS-1045
infra-bot: policy shows `group:legacy-deployers@redwood` and an old `serviceAccount:ext-deployer@partners.iam.gserviceaccount.com` binding.
ben: removing ext-deployer binding now: `gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding legacy-wrap --member=serviceAccount:ext-deployer@partners.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` (done).
mica: good. we should run a full Vault scan for any values matching SA JSON pattern and a GCS/Artifact scan for the same. create tickets for both.
claire: starting Vault grep: `vault kv list -format=json secret/ | xargs -n1 vault kv get -format=json | jq -r '..|.private_key? // empty'` -> found additional matches, will add to SEC-4120.
ben: temporary mitigations I'm doing: 1) revoke exposed SA keys 2) create new SA keys 3) envelope-encrypt with KMS wrap key 4) store only ciphertext in Vault under secret/qa/* 5) update helper to decrypt in-memory.
mica: add to checklist: enable Vault audit on those namespaces (retention 90d), add Terraform/OPA policy to forbid writes that match SA JSON pattern, and add a pre-commit hook that rejects keyfile patterns.
infra-bot: [Task] created OPS-1046 vault-scan-and-migrate assigned=infra-team schedule=immediate
claire: partner teams? partner-legacy contains a partner key. compliance: do we need to notify partner or legal?
compliance: depends on exposure window and whether key was used. provide timeline and whether the key was present in any public mirrors. for now mark as internal P1. I'll log SEC-4120 and advise next steps once you post the revoked key IDs.
ben: note for runbook: publish an example in-runbook using KMS envelope + Vault ciphertext and a helper that decrypts in-memory only (no disk writes). snippet for runbook: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create - --iam-account=... | gcloud kms encrypt --key=legacy-wrap --keyring=shared --location=global --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=- | vault kv put secret/qa/batch-sync wrapped=@-` (illustrative; ensure binary safe handling).
mica: detection rule: add regex to log and artifact processors: `(\\{\\s*\"type\"\\s*:\\s*\"service_account\\"|\"private_key\"\\s*:)` and fail CI/pre-merge on matches. also create a quarantine workflow if detected.
claire: timeline so far: detection 1940012345, temporary KMS regrant 1940013000, key revocations started 1940013600, ciphertext stored 1940014200, vault-scan kick-off 1940014800. ETA for sweep completion 1940020000.
ben: one operational caveat: some legacy tests relied on plaintext keys baked into fixtures. we'll need to update test infra to fetch wrapped keys and decrypt in CI ephemeral runners. add item to infra backlog.
mica: post-incident actions: - migrate all plaintext secrets out of Vault to ciphertext-only entries under secret/*/wrapped - enable Vault audits for those namespaces 90-180d - harden KMS policies and rotate keys if shared - update CI/tests to use in-memory decrypt - add pre-merge scans and repo sweeps - tabletop run to exercise this flow next sprint.
claire: I've created SEC-4120 with details and attached list of affected Vault paths and revoked key IDs. tagging infra for sweep results. thanks everyone for quick response. :thumbsup:
